The macOS app opens again, saved words line up in PDFs, and LinguaReader has a new icon.

## Fixed
- **macOS: no more "LinguaReader is damaged and can't be opened".** The Mac app is now signed (ad-hoc), so macOS stops calling it damaged. It still isn't notarized by Apple, so the first time you open it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Highlights and selections line up in text PDFs.** Since 1.2.0, words in text PDFs sat about one letter to the right, so saved-word highlights and selections were slightly off. They now sit on the word again.
- **Linux: the app has its icon again.** Linux builds had shipped without an app icon.

## New
- **New app icon:** an open book with one highlighted word. The sidebar uses the same mark.

## Notes
- If you're still on 1.2.1 or earlier on a Mac and see the "damaged" message, run `xattr -cr /Applications/LinguaReader.app` in Terminal once, or install 1.2.2.
- On macOS the app tells you about new versions and opens the Releases page. On Windows and Linux, updates install in the app.
- The Windows build isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn the first time you open the app.
